# Pusaka

> NFTs on NEAR that hold native Bitcoin. Each Pusaka (NEP-171 token) controls its own Bitcoin address through NEAR Chain Signatures; selling the NFT transfers control of the BTC in one NEAR transaction, with no bridge, wrapped BTC or custodian.

Each Pusaka also holds ETH and USDC on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum (same secp256k1 MPC key), SOL (Ed25519 MPC key), and has its own NEAR account (the implicit account of that Ed25519 key), which can hold nBTC (Omni Bridge NEP-141, minted from the Pusaka's own BTC). Selling the NFT moves all of them, plus a sealed letter only the current holder can read (encrypted with a NEAR MPC confidential key, CKD); creators earn 2.5% on resales (NEP-199). A holder can name an heir (`set_heir`): if they stay silent (no `still_here` check-in) for the chosen time, the heir claims the Pusaka with `claim_inheritance`; `heir_of` shows it.

USDC deposits on Base and Arbitrum are attested by NEAR MPC foreign-transaction verification: the MPC network reads the finalized chain itself, so `usdc_info` on the contract is trustworthy without any EVM RPC. Every Bitcoin withdrawal carries an `OP_RETURN pusaka:{id}` output. The deployed wasm is a NEP-330 reproducible build (`contract_source_metadata`).

Network: NEAR testnet (contract `pusaka-btc.testnet`, MPC signer `v1.signer-prod.testnet`), Bitcoin testnet3 (tracked by NEAR's Bitcoin light client `btc-client-v4.testnet`), Sepolia, Base Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Solana devnet.

## How to use this site

- `/#/` lists every Pusaka with the BTC verified on NEAR, the total across all of them, and the standing loan offers (yearly rate, which Pusakas qualify).
- `/#/gift/{key}`: a gift link. Whoever opens it claims the Pusaka (and the Bitcoin it controls) into a connected wallet or a brand-new account, signed with the link's key; no wallet or NEAR needed (the contract's NEP-452 linkdrop: `gift`, `claim`, `create_account_and_claim`, `cancel_gift`, views `gift_of`, `gift_for_key`).
- `/#/mine` (wallet connected): the Pusakas you hold, your loans, your standing loan offers, and the ones naming you as heir.
- Deadlines (a loan's due date, an heir's claim date) offer a calendar reminder: an RFC 5545 `.ics` with an alarm, or Google Calendar.
- `/#/pusaka/{id}` shows one Pusaka: Bitcoin address (with a BIP21 `bitcoin:` link), BTC proven by the light client, ETH/USDC per chain (with MPC-verified USDC), SOL, its NEAR account and its nBTC, a holder room (NEP-413 sign-in), a ledger of holders, sales, royalties and payouts, and actions (mint, list or Dutch auction, buy, borrow, lend, withdraw) after connecting a NEAR testnet wallet.

## For agents

- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, read-only): https://pusaka-two.vercel.app/api/mcp — tools `pusaka_overview`, `pusaka_loan_offers` (standing loan offers with LTV/APR), `pusaka_inspect` (verified BTC, USD value, ETH/USDC per chain, SOL and NEAR-account balances with safe/at-risk, listing premium, loan LTV/APR, and `exit_quote`: a live NEAR Intents 1Click quote, solver-signed and dry-run, for selling its verified BTC into USDC on Base). Plus due diligence: `pusaka_contract_trust` (code sha256 and reproducible-build source, keys on the contract account, the DAO council and threshold that can change code, timelock, pending upgrade), `pusaka_audit` (independent proof of reserves: MPC key derivation re-checked, verified sats recomputed, every deposit looked up on Bitcoin incl. unspent), `pusaka_history` (holders, sale prices, loans), `pusaka_credit_record` (a borrower's repaid/refinanced/defaulted loans), `pusaka_loan_watch` (funded loans, hours left, live LTV, your next move).
- Trading tools run locally: `mcp/server.mjs` in the repo, with your own NEAR key and a spend cap: `pusaka_buy`, `pusaka_fund_loan` (refuses above max LTV, and unless BTC/NEAR prices agree within 5% across two sources), `pusaka_repay_loan`, `pusaka_claim_collateral`, `pusaka_list`, `pusaka_cancel_listing`, `pusaka_request_loan`, `pusaka_offer_loan` (escrows a standing offer; refuses above max LTV), `pusaka_cancel_loan_offer`, `pusaka_accept_loan_offer` (also refinances a funded loan: the offer pays the current lender in full), `pusaka_repay_partial`, `pusaka_propose_extension`, `pusaka_accept_extension`, `pusaka_gift_link` / `pusaka_claim_gift` / `pusaka_cancel_gift` / `pusaka_gift_preview`, `pusaka_prove_deposits` (BTC and USDC), `pusaka_give`, `pusaka_mint`, `pusaka_set_heir`, `pusaka_still_here`, `pusaka_claim_inheritance`, and withdrawals `pusaka_withdraw_btc|eth|sol|near|nbtc` (off unless `PUSAKA_ALLOW_OUTFLOWS=1`; `PUSAKA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS` restricts where).
- Contract views (no key needed): `upgrade_status` (code changes: Sputnik DAO vote, then a timelock), `token_info`, `loan_offers` (standing offers, escrowed principal), `loan_extension`, `heir_of`, `usdc_info`, `evm_address`, `near_nonce_floor`, `nft_tokens`, `contract_source_metadata`.
- Proof of reserves (JSON, CORS open): `GET /api/reserves`. Badge: `GET /api/badge?id={id}` (SVG).
- Holder room: `POST /api/holder {"token_id", "auth": NEP-413 {accountId, publicKey, signature, message: "Open the holder room of Pusaka #{id}
at {ms}", nonce (base64, 32 bytes), at}}`, recipient = this host. Opens only for the current holder.
- Gas-free deposit proofs: `POST /api/prove {"token_id": "1"}`.
- Gas-free owner actions (NEP-366): `POST /api/relay {"signed_delegate": "<base64 borsh SignedDelegate>"}` for list, cancel_listing, request_loan, cancel_loan_request, claim_collateral, still_here, claim_inheritance, and accept_loan_offer (borrow against a Pusaka with no NEAR at all: offers of >= 0.01 NEAR the contract would accept, once a minute per token).
